clue.text: Disaster that could make one tremble?

definitions.text: Disaster that could make one tremble?

parts.words: Disaster that could make one tremble?

explanation.definitionFit: A seismic catastrophe in which the ground shakes violently, literally the world trembling.

explanation.surface: A fool gives a pointless, never-ending maiden speech.

clue.text: Marvellous day with Ukraine volunteers climbing on tip of Everest that's over-steep

explanation.surface: Ukrainian volunteers enjoy a marvellous day summiting Everest.

explanation.definitionFit: To steep is to soak; to overdo the soaking past the normal limit is to drench beyond full capacity.

clue.text: Drop one's Hs?

clue.text: Unenlightened girl with articles for sale…

explanation.definitionFit: A rhizome is a horizontal underground stem that sends out roots and shoots, which botanists also call a rootstock.

clue.text: Time to muse

parts.note: an era is a period of time
taken as written

clue.text: Apres moi le deluge?

clue.text: Prince Charming partially disturbed

partially says only part of the word Charming is used

explanation.definitionFit: An amir, or emir, is a Muslim ruler or commander, a princely title.

clue.text: Insect has time to poke about vegetable

explanation.definitionFit: Beetroot is a dark red root crop eaten boiled or pickled.

clue.text: Emperor ordering start, but not end

explanation.definitionFit: The tsar was the title of the Russian monarch, an emperor.

clue.text: Tempt cat with tart, possibly

clue.text: Drunken urge for food

clue.text: Withdraws religious education pamphlets
